title: Kiro Factory instance config (factory-config.json)
description: Every value specific to one factory instance. Integration-specific fields are validated by each integration's own config.schema.json. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored.

_schema.description: The config format's version. The Manual raises it when it changes a field an existing config sets, so an older config fails the render instead of being read differently.

name.description: Short id, used in fences and run keys.

title.description: The factory's name, in bold in the first line of every post it makes and on its pages. Default: the name, capitalised, then 'Factory'. Later runs find the factory's own posts by that line, so changing it on a live board strands the earlier ones.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone worker schedules are read in, unless a worker sets its own. Default UTC.

workers.description: Per-worker settings, keyed by worker name. A Manual step's defaults.json gives the defaults; set `enabled` to turn a step on or off, and add a key the Manual does not ship to add an instance worker.

goal.description: What the factory is for in this instance, in a few plain sentences. Every agent worker reads it with the instance rules, and learn's page opens with it and that run's assessment against it.

modules.description: Modules this instance runs, in order, each given to the render as --module <name>=<dir>. A module adds workers and the skills existing workers load (render.py, Modules).

schedule.description: Five-field cron expression, read in the worker's timezone.

timeoutSecs.description: How long one run may take before the runner stops it. At least 60 for an agent worker.

script.description: The executable for this worker, under the instance's scripts/. A .py runs with the host's Python. Replaces the Manual's.

settings.description: Values the worker's implementation reads. Each must be a setting its Manual step's defaults.json, or the module declaring the worker, lists (render.py); an instance's own worker takes any.

agent.description: The prompt for this worker, relative to the instance directory. Replaces the Manual's.

skills.description: Skills this worker's prompt names as its own, added to the step's. Every skill loads its body only when the prompt or its description calls for it.

verification.description: Signals the agent gathers before its verification decision, added to the step's defaults. An entry naming a default signal (its skill name or its script file name as defaults.json writes it) with enabled false turns that default off. A new script path is relative to the instance and under scripts/.
